kindoo.//eid: Numeric environment id for your site (EnvironmentID from KindooGetEnvironments).

server.//host: 127.0.0.1 means this machine only. Change only behind an authenticating proxy.
server.//public_url: Base URL used in emailed links. Must be reachable by the recipient -- not localhost.

//smtp: Outgoing mail, used to prove someone owns an address before they can set a password. Any relay works -- e.g. Gmail with an App Password. Leave host empty and links are written to the server log instead, which is NOT verification.
//allowed_emails: Only these addresses may create an account. Everyone else is refused at sign-up. Accounts are created by signing up in the app, never here -- passwords and each manager's Kindoo token live in the database, so no credential belongs in this file.
//automated_accounts: Service accounts that bulk-create users; shown as 'an automated sync' instead of a raw address.
//units: One entry per unit. `name` is required. `town` enables matching a bare town name -- but only where that town has exactly one unit; a town listed by several is never guessed. `write_as` is the exact text used when creating a user, for sites whose real data has odd spacing. `aliases` are other spellings seen in the wild.
//seat_allocation: Seats each unit is expected to stay within. One figure for the whole site; 0 means usage isn't measured against one.
